database_schema.summary: Stores customers, quotations, projects, catalog items, outsource staff, and users

tables.name: CatalogItem
tables.purpose: Reusable templates for scope, deliverables, pricing

database_schema.relationships_explained: 1 Customer có nhiều Quotations và Projects. 1 Quotation có nhiều QuotationLines và PaymentMilestones. QuotationLines có thể link tới OutsourcingStaff.

api_endpoints.explained: Quản lý khách hàng - lấy danh sách và tạo mới
Quản lý báo giá - lấy danh sách, tạo mới, tìm kiếm theo status
Chi tiết báo giá - xem, cập nhật, xóa
Master data catalog - scope, deliverables, pricing templates
AI parsing voice transcript thành quotation data
AI OCR business card image thành customer data
AI gợi ý giá Min/Avg/Max dựa trên lịch sử
AI tạo lời mở đầu chuyên nghiệp cho báo giá
AI chatbot streaming - tạo báo giá bằng chat tự nhiên
Thống kê dashboard - revenue, quotations, projects
Cron job - gửi báo cáo tuần qua email
Cron job - kiểm tra deadline và gửi reminder

business_rules: Email triggers: Auto-send on quotation create/accept
AI pricing confidence threshold: > 0.7 for reliable suggestions
Intro text generation: 150-200 words, Vietnamese formal business tone

features.name: Email Automation
features.description: Auto-send branded emails on quotation events + weekly reports

features.name: Dashboard Alerts
features.description: Real-time alerts for deadlines, pending quotations, cash flow

features.name: Voice-to-Quotation
features.description: Speech recognition + AI parsing to create quotations

features.name: Business Card Scanner
features.description: Camera OCR with AI Vision to extract customer data

features.name: Smart Pricing Suggestions
features.description: AI analyzes history to suggest Min/Avg/Max prices

features.name: Auto Intro Generator
features.description: AI writes personalized introduction text for quotations

features.name: AI Assistant Chatbot
features.description: Conversational AI to help create quotations via chat

features.name: Predictive Analytics
features.description: Deal scoring, revenue forecasting, customer insights

patterns: All AI features use lib/ai/* for centralized logic
API routes use NextResponse.json() for consistent responses
Forms use React Hook Form + Zod for validation
Streaming responses use ReadableStream for real-time AI
gotchas: Prisma with SQLite: Can't use `mode: 'insensitive'` in dev, only in PostgreSQL production
Voice recognition: Web Speech API only works in Chrome/Edge
AI responses: Always include confidence scores for transparency
Line items: isChargeable flag determines if included in total
conventions: File naming: kebab-case for all files
API responses: { success: boolean, data?: any, error?: string }
AI prompts: Stored in lib/ai/*.ts for version control
